_doc: Unlocks (docs/CONTENT.md sections 13 and 19): things a landmark or an ending opens for the NEXT runs. They widen choice, never raw power. Kept in the profile (user://profile.json), not in the run; an event's `unlock` effect earns one (shown as "Unlocked: <name>"). Packs add theirs in their own unlocks.json. Each entry: id, kind, name, how (the hint the hangar shows on a locked starter: say how it is earned) and payload. kind and payload: starter_ship {ship: a design id of data/ships or a pack's ships/; the design's hangar.unlock names this unlock}, species_start {species, name?}, blueprint {blueprint: a recipe id}, map_variant {variant, tide_steps}, skin {skin, tint?, lamp?}. What each kind does at the start of a run (scripts/space/run_start.gd; the hangar shows them as a row of choices under the ship, and remembers the choice in the profile): starter_ship opens its design in the hangar. species_start lets you swap your soldier (the player's crew member) for one of that species, named `name` when it has one. blueprint is known in the ship's fabricator at the start of EVERY new run once earned (no choice). map_variant is an opt-in harder map: the flag variant_<variant> is set for the run and the Hollow tide of every region starts `tide_steps` steps on (it loses that much of its grace). skin tints the exterior hull plating (tile_art.gd draw_skin multiplies the line's own tint by `tint`) and colours its lamps with `lamp`; both are #rrggbb. A skin with neither draws as the plain hull. Unknown payload keys are errors (Unlocks.validate). The core list is empty: the endings pack holds the first ones.
